package com.studentplanner.app;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlarmManager;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.Signature;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Insets;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.view.WindowInsets;
import android.view.WindowInsetsController;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.webkit.JavascriptInterface;
import android.webkit.ValueCallback;
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient;
import android.webkit.WebResourceRequest;
import android.webkit.WebResourceResponse;
import android.webkit.WebSettings;
import android.webkit.WebView;
import android.webkit.WebViewClient;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.webkit.WebViewAssetLoader;

import com.android.billingclient.api.AcknowledgePurchaseParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClient;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingClientStateListener;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingFlowParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.BillingResult;
import com.android.billingclient.api.PendingPurchasesParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.ProductDetails;
import com.android.billingclient.api.Purchase;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryProductDetailsParams;
import com.android.billingclient.api.QueryPurchasesParams;

import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public class MainActivity extends Activity {
    // Subscription product id you create in Google Play Console (Monetize > Subscriptions).
    static final String SKU = "pro_monthly";
    // SHA-256 (hex, no colons) of your signing certificate. Empty = skip the check.
    static final String EXPECTED_SIG = "";
    static final String HOST = "appassets.androidplatform.net";
    // True while the app is on screen. The timer alarm stays quiet then because the page beeps itself.
    static volatile boolean fg = false;

    private WebView web;
    private ValueCallback<Uri[]> picker;
    private BillingClient bc;
    private ProductDetails details;
    private volatile boolean pro = false;
    private volatile String priceText = "\u20B910 / month";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle b) {
        super.onCreate(b);
        if (!sigOk()) { finish(); return; }
        getWindow().setFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE, WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE);
        ReminderReceiver.channels(this);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
            && checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS}, 1);
        }
        web = new WebView(this);
        web.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#f4f4f6"));
        setContentView(web);
        // Android 15+ draws apps edge to edge, so keep the page clear of the status bar,
        // navigation bar and keyboard.
        web.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener((v, ins) -> {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30) {
                Insets i = ins.getInsets(WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() | WindowInsets.Type.ime()
                    | WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout());
                v.setPadding(i.left, i.top, i.right, i.bottom);
            } else {
                v.setPadding(ins.getSystemWindowInsetLeft(), ins.getSystemWindowInsetTop(),
                    ins.getSystemWindowInsetRight(), ins.getSystemWindowInsetBottom());
            }
            return ins;
        });
        WebSettings s = web.getSettings();
        s.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
        s.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
        s.setAllowFileAccess(false);
        s.setAllowContentAccess(false);
        s.setSupportZoom(false);
        s.setBuiltInZoomControls(false);
        s.setDisplayZoomControls(false);
        s.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false);
        web.setOverScrollMode(WebView.OVER_SCROLL_NEVER);
        web.addJavascriptInterface(new Bridge(), "Android");

        final WebViewAssetLoader loader = new WebViewAssetLoader.Builder()
            .addPathHandler("/assets/", new WebViewAssetLoader.AssetsPathHandler(this)).build();
        web.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
            @Override
            public WebResourceResponse shouldInterceptRequest(WebView v, WebResourceRequest r) {
                return loader.shouldInterceptRequest(r.getUrl());
            }
            @Override
            public boolean shouldOverrideUrlLoading(WebView v, WebResourceRequest r) {
                return !HOST.equals(r.getUrl().getHost());
            }
        });
        web.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient() {
            @Override
            public boolean onShowFileChooser(WebView v, ValueCallback<Uri[]> cb, FileChooserParams p) {
                if (picker != null) picker.onReceiveValue(null);
                picker = cb;
                try {
                    startActivityForResult(p.createIntent(), 7);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    picker = null;
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            }
        });
        web.loadUrl("https://" + HOST + "/assets/index.html");
        initBilling();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int rq, int rs, Intent d) {
        if (rq == 7 && picker != null) {
            picker.onReceiveValue(WebChromeClient.FileChooserParams.parseResult(rs, d));
            picker = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int rc, String[] p, int[] r) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(rc, p, r);
        if (rc == 1 && r.length > 0 && r[0] == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            SharedPreferences sp = getSharedPreferences("r", MODE_PRIVATE);
            String t = sp.getString("wt", null);
            if (t != null) {
                ReminderReceiver.show(this, 7001, t, sp.getString("wb", ""), false);
                sp.edit().remove("wt").remove("wb").apply();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        fg = true;
        if (bc != null && bc.isReady()) queryPurchases();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        fg = false;
        if (web != null) web.evaluateJavascript("window.__flush&&__flush()", null);
        super.onPause();
    }

    private void toast(final String m) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, m, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
    }

    private void welcome(final String t, final String b) {
        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        if (nm.areNotificationsEnabled()) {
            ReminderReceiver.show(this, 7001, t, b, false);
        } else {
            getSharedPreferences("r", MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putString("wt", t).putString("wb", b).apply();
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS}, 1));
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing ----
    private void initBilling() {
        bc = BillingClient.newBuilder(this)
            .setListener((r, list) -> {
                if (r.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK && list != null) handle(list);
            })
            .enablePendingPurchases(PendingPurchasesParams.newBuilder().enableOneTimeProducts().build())
            .build();
        bc.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
            @Override public void onBillingSetupFinished(BillingResult r) {
                if (r.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                    queryPurchases();
                    queryDetails();
                }
            }
            @Override public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() { }
        });
    }

    private void queryPurchases() {
        bc.queryPurchasesAsync(
            QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder().setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS).build(),
            (r, list) -> { if (r.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) handle(list); });
    }

    private void queryDetails() {
        QueryProductDetailsParams q = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
            .setProductList(Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                    .setProductId(SKU).setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS).build()))
            .build();
        bc.queryProductDetailsAsync(q, (r, list) -> {
            if (r.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK && list != null && !list.isEmpty()) {
                details = list.get(0);
                List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> o = details.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
                if (o != null && !o.isEmpty()) {
                    priceText = o.get(0).getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList().get(0).getFormattedPrice() + " / month";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void handle(List<Purchase> list) {
        boolean p = false;
        for (Purchase pu : list) {
            if (pu.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED && pu.getProducts().contains(SKU)) {
                p = true;
                if (!pu.isAcknowledged()) {
                    bc.acknowledgePurchase(
                        AcknowledgePurchaseParams.newBuilder().setPurchaseToken(pu.getPurchaseToken()).build(), r -> { });
                }
            }
        }
        pro = p;
        runOnUiThread(() -> web.evaluateJavascript("window.onPro&&onPro()", null));
    }

    private void subscribe() {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (bc == null || details == null) return;
            List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> o = details.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
            if (o == null || o.isEmpty()) return;
            BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams pd = BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductDetails(details).setOfferToken(o.get(0).getOfferToken()).build();
            bc.launchBillingFlow(this, BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductDetailsParamsList(Collections.singletonList(pd)).build());
        });
    }

    // ---- tamper check ----
    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private boolean sigOk() {
        if (EXPECTED_SIG.isEmpty()) return true;
        try {
            Signature[] sigs;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) {
                sigs = getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(getPackageName(), PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES)
                    .signingInfo.getApkContentsSigners();
            } else {
                sigs = getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(getPackageName(), PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES).signatures;
            }
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            for (Signature g : sigs) {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (byte x : md.digest(g.toByteArray())) sb.append(String.format("%02x", x));
                if (sb.toString().equalsIgnoreCase(EXPECTED_SIG)) return true;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return false;
    }

    // ---- JS bridge ----
    class Bridge {
        // Debug builds are unlocked so you can test; release builds follow Google Play only.
        @JavascriptInterface public boolean isPro() { return BuildConfig.DEBUG || pro; }
        @JavascriptInterface public String price() { return priceText; }
        @JavascriptInterface public void subscribe() { MainActivity.this.subscribe(); }
        @JavascriptInterface public void refresh() {
            runOnUiThread(() -> { if (bc != null && bc.isReady()) queryPurchases(); });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface public void sync(String json) { ReminderReceiver.schedule(MainActivity.this, json); }
        @JavascriptInterface public void timerStart(double end, String label) {
            ReminderReceiver.timer(MainActivity.this, (long) end, label);
        }
        @JavascriptInterface public void timerCancel() { ReminderReceiver.cancelTimer(MainActivity.this); }
        @JavascriptInterface public void welcome(String t, String b) { MainActivity.this.welcome(t, b); }
        @JavascriptInterface public String tones() { return ReminderReceiver.tones(MainActivity.this); }
        @JavascriptInterface public void setTones(String timerUri, String notifUri) { ReminderReceiver.setTones(MainActivity.this, timerUri, notifUri); }
        @JavascriptInterface public String statusTones() { return ReminderReceiver.statusTones(MainActivity.this); }

        @JavascriptInterface public String status() {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) getSystemService(ALARM_SERVICE);
            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
            boolean n = nm.areNotificationsEnabled();
            boolean ex = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 || am.canScheduleExactAlarms();
            boolean bat = pm.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(getPackageName());
            return "{\"v\":3,\"notif\":" + n + ",\"exact\":" + ex + ",\"battery\":" + bat + "}";
        }

        @JavascriptInterface public void open(final String what) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    Intent i;
                    String pkg = getPackageName();
                    if ("notif".equals(what)) {
                        i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, pkg);
                    } else if ("battery".equals(what)) {
                        i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS, Uri.parse("package:" + pkg));
                    } else if ("exact".equals(what) && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
                        i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM, Uri.parse("package:" + pkg));
                    } else {
                        i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS, Uri.parse("package:" + pkg));
                    }
                    i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                    startActivity(i);
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            });
        }

        // Matches the system bars to the app theme.
        @JavascriptInterface public void setBars(final String hex, final boolean dark) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    int c = Color.parseColor(hex);
                    getWindow().getDecorView().setBackgroundColor(c);
                    web.setBackgroundColor(c);
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30) {
                        WindowInsetsController wc = getWindow().getInsetsController();
                        if (wc != null) {
                            int m = WindowInsetsController.APPEARANCE_LIGHT_STATUS_BARS
                                | WindowInsetsController.APPEARANCE_LIGHT_NAVIGATION_BARS;
                            wc.setSystemBarsAppearance(dark ? 0 : m, m);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            });
        }

        // Saves an .ics file to Downloads and opens it in the calendar app.
        @JavascriptInterface public void saveIcs(String name, String text) {
            Uri u = null;
            try {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 29) { toast("Calendar export needs Android 10 or newer."); return; }
                ContentValues v = new ContentValues();
                v.put(MediaStore.Downloads.DISPLAY_NAME, name);
                v.put(MediaStore.Downloads.MIME_TYPE, "text/calendar");
                v.put(MediaStore.Downloads.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
                u = getContentResolver().insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, v);
                OutputStream o = getContentResolver().openOutputStream(u);
                o.write(text.getBytes("UTF-8"));
                o.close();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                toast("Could not save the calendar file.");
                return;
            }
            try {
                Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);
                i.setDataAndType(u, "text/calendar");
                i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                startActivity(i);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                toast("Saved to your Downloads folder. Open it to add the events to your calendar.");
            }
        }
    }
}
=====FILE app/src/main/java/com/studentplanner/app/ReminderReceiver.java=====
package com.studentplanner.app;

import android.app.AlarmManager;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.RingtoneManager;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

public class ReminderReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {
    static final String CH_ALARM = "alarm4";
    static final String CH_INFO = "info4";
    static final int TIMER_ID = 9001;

    static Uri toneUri(Context c, String key, int type) {
        String s = c.getSharedPreferences("r", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getString(key, "");
        if (s != null && !s.isEmpty()) {
            try { return Uri.parse(s); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        }
        return RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(type);
    }

    static void channels(Context c) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 26) return;
        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) c.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        AudioAttributes aa = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION).build();
        NotificationChannel a = new NotificationChannel(CH_ALARM, "Timer and reminders", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH);
        a.setSound(toneUri(c, "timerTone", RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM), aa);
        a.enableVibration(true);
        a.setVibrationPattern(new long[]{0, 500, 250, 500, 250, 500});
        nm.createNotificationChannel(a);
        NotificationChannel i = new NotificationChannel(CH_INFO, "Notifications", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT);
        i.setSound(toneUri(c, "notifTone", RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION), aa);
        nm.createNotificationChannel(i);
    }

    static String tones(Context c) {
        JSONArray out = new JSONArray();
        Cursor cur = null;
        try {
            cur = RingtoneManager.getCursor(c, RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION);
            while (cur.moveToNext()) {
                String title = cur.getString(RingtoneManager.TITLE_COLUMN_INDEX);
                String uri = cur.getString(RingtoneManager.URI_COLUMN_INDEX);
                String id = cur.getString(RingtoneManager.ID_COLUMN_INDEX);
                JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
                o.put("title", title == null ? "Notification sound" : title);
                o.put("uri", uri + "/" + id);
                out.put(o);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally { if (cur != null) cur.close(); }
        return out.toString();
    }

    static String statusTones(Context c) {
        SharedPreferences sp = c.getSharedPreferences("r", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return "{\"timer\":"+JSONObject.quote(sp.getString("timerTone", ""))+ ",\"notif\":"+JSONObject.quote(sp.getString("notifTone", ""))+"}";
    }

    static void setTones(Context c, String timerUri, String notifUri) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) c.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            nm.deleteNotificationChannel(CH_ALARM);
            nm.deleteNotificationChannel(CH_INFO);
        }
        c.getSharedPreferences("r", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
            .putString("timerTone", timerUri == null ? "" : timerUri)
            .putString("notifTone", notifUri == null ? "" : notifUri).apply();
        channels(c);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    static void show(Context c, int id, String title, String body, boolean alarm) {
        channels(c);
        if (body == null) body = "";
        NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager) c.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        Notification.Builder b;
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            b = new Notification.Builder(c, alarm ? CH_ALARM : CH_INFO);
        } else {
            b = new Notification.Builder(c);
            if (alarm) {
                b.setSound(RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_ALARM));
                b.setVibrate(new long[]{0, 500, 250, 500, 250, 500});
                b.setPriority(Notification.PRIORITY_HIGH);
            }
        }
        PendingIntent open = PendingIntent.getActivity(c, 0, new Intent(c, MainActivity.class),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE | PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        b.setSmallIcon(com.studentplanner.app.R.drawable.ic_notification)
         .setContentTitle(title)
         .setContentText(body)
         .setStyle(new Notification.BigTextStyle().bigText(body))
         .setAutoCancel(true)
         .setContentIntent(open);
        if (alarm) b.setCategory(Notification.CATEGORY_ALARM);
        Notification n = b.build();
        nm.notify(id, n);
    }

    static PendingIntent pi(Context c, int id, String kind, String t, String b) {
        Intent i = new Intent(c, ReminderReceiver.class);
        i.putExtra("k", kind);
        i.putExtra("t", t);
        i.putExtra("b", b);
        i.putExtra("i", id);
        return PendingIntent.getBroadcast(c, id, i, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
    }

    static void arm(Context c, long at, PendingIntent p) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) c.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31 && !am.canScheduleExactAlarms()) {
                am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, p);
            } else {
                am.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, p);
            }
        } catch (SecurityException e) {
            am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, at, p);
        }
    }

    static void timer(Context c, long end, String label) {
        arm(c, end, pi(c, TIMER_ID, "timer", label + " done", "Time is up. Take a short break."));
    }

    static void cancelTimer(Context c) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) c.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        am.cancel(pi(c, TIMER_ID, "timer", "", ""));
    }

    static void schedule(Context c, String json) {
        try {
            AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) c.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
            SharedPreferences sp = c.getSharedPreferences("r", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            int old = sp.getInt("n", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < old; i++) am.cancel(pi(c, i, "rem", "", ""));
            JSONArray a = new JSONArray(json);
            int n = Math.min(a.length(), 60);
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                JSONObject o = a.getJSONObject(i);
                long at = o.getLong("at");

<!DOCTYPE html>

<style>

:root[data-skin="forest"]{--bg:#0e1912;--card:#16261c;--pill:#203428;--ink:#e9f5ec;--mut:#8fb09a;--track:#2a4435;--b:#5fbf7a;--g:#4cd07d;--r:#ff7a6b;color-scheme:dark}

:root[data-skin="lavender"]{--bg:#f2efff;--card:#e5deff;--pill:#fbfaff;--ink:#1d1635;--mut:#756c99;--track:#d3c9f6;--b:#7b5cf0;--g:#2fa35b;--r:#e0483b;color-scheme:light}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
body{font-family:'Manrope',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
main{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 18px 120px}
#app>*+*{margin-top:14px}
h1{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.15}
h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.sub,.lbl{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.lbl{display:block;font-size:17px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:22px!important;margin-bottom:-4px}
.card{background:var(--card);border-radius:26px;padding:18px}
.grid{display:grid;gap:12px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}

.sec{margin-top:28px!important;align-items:baseline}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:transform .08s}
button:active{transform:scale(.95)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit;width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:16px}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus,button:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--b)}
::placeholder{color:var(--mut)}
.lnk{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;white-space:nowrap;padding:6px 2px}
.danger{color:var(--r)}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:26px}
.circ{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px;line-height:1;flex:none;background:var(--track)}
.circ.sm{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:17px}
.gr{background:var(--g);color:#fff}.rd{background:var(--r);color:#fff}.add{background:var(--b);color:#fff}
.home{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.today{grid-row:span 2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.today .t{font-size:22px;font-weight:700}
.mini span{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.mini b{font-size:17px;font-weight:600}
.small{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;text-align:left;gap:2px;min-height:96px}
.small span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}.small b{font-size:17px;font-weight:600}
.prow{padding:14px 14px 14px 18px;gap:10px}
.pmain{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left}
.pmain b{font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

.bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px}

.advice{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:0 14px;margin-top:2px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);text-align:center}
.stats span{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}.stats b{font-size:26px;font-weight:600}
.mark b{font-size:19px;font-weight:600}
input[type=range]{padding:0;background:none;accent-color:var(--b);height:30px}
.note{display:grid;gap:12px}
input.ntitle{background:none;padding:0;font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.note textarea{background:var(--pill);resize:vertical;min-height:84px}
.note input.sin{background:var(--pill);padding:12px 16px;font-size:15px}
.subs{display:grid;gap:8px;padding-left:10px;border-left:3px solid var(--track)}
.sn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--pill);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 8px 8px 10px}
.sn span{flex:1;font-size:15px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sn.dn span{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--mut)}
.chk{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid var(--mut);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-size:15px;color:#fff}
.dn .chk{background:var(--g);border-color:var(--g)}
.x{color:var(--mut);font-size:22px;width:30px;height:30px;line-height:1}
nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:14px 18px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--bg) 40%)}
nav div{display:flex;gap:4px;background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:6px;width:100%;max-width:440px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
nav button{flex:1;height:50px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}
nav button.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
nav svg{width:21px;height:21px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

nav button span{display:none}nav button.on span{display:inline}nav button.on{flex:2.2}
.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
.top h1{margin-top:2px}
.gear{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.gear svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.evs{display:grid;gap:10px}
.ev .when{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.ev .nm{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.today .lnk{align-self:flex-start;padding-left:0;margin-top:auto}
.tbtn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.big{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.small .lnk{align-self:flex-start;padding:2px 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:10}
.sheet{background:var(--bg);width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:28px 28px 0 0;padding:22px 18px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:grid;gap:12px}
.sheet .go{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.evrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 6px 10px 14px}
.evrow div{flex:1;min-width:0}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.due{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
input.pd{background:var(--pill);padding:12px 16px;font-size:15px}

body,.card,.gear,nav div,.sheet,input,textarea,select,.chip,.wsw,.tool{transition:background-color .3s ease,color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease}
button{transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1.4),background-color .35s ease,color .35s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
nav button{transition:flex .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background-color .35s ease,color .35s ease,transform .15s ease}
#wall{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;transform:translateZ(0);will-change:transform}
.wp #wall::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--bg);opacity:.6}
.wp nav{background:none}
.wp .card,.wp .gear,.wp nav div,.wp .sheet{background:var(--card);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--card) 90%,transparent)}
.wp input,.wp select,.wp textarea,.wp .sn,.wp .evrow{background:var(--pill);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pill) 94%,transparent)}
.wp input.ntitle,.wp .qn textarea{background:none}
.qn{justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px}
.qn textarea{background:none;padding:0;border-radius:0;flex:1;min-height:70px;resize:none;font-size:15px}
.qn textarea:focus{box-shadow:none}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px 8px 8px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;border:2px solid transparent}
.chip i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--track)}
.wsw{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid transparent;background:var(--card);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--track)}
.chip.sel,.wsw.sel{border-color:var(--b)}
.up{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes arcin{from{stroke-dasharray:0 100}}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}}
@keyframes up{from{transform:translateY(60px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes fadeout{to{opacity:0}}
@keyframes down{to{transform:translateY(60px);opacity:0}}
.anim>*{animation:rise .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.anim>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s}.anim>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.1s}.anim>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s}.anim>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.2s}.anim>*:nth-child(n+6){animation-delay:.25s}
.anim .bar i{transform-origin:left;animation:grow .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .15s both}
.anim .garc{animation:arcin 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.scrim.enter{animation:fade .25s ease both}.sheet.enter{animation:up .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.scrim.leave{animation:fadeout .22s ease forwards}.scrim.leave .sheet{animation:down .22s ease forwards}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

.go{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;width:100%}
.evc{display:grid;gap:8px}
.lockscr{align-items:center;background:var(--bg)}
.lockscr .sheet{border-radius:28px;margin:0 18px;text-align:center}
.lk nav,.lk main{display:none}
nav button{position:relative}
nav button.hasdot::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:7px;right:9px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--r);border:2px solid var(--card);animation:none}
nav button.on.hasdot::after{border-color:var(--ink)}

#toasts{position:fixed;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));left:12px;right:12px;z-index:30;display:grid;gap:8px;max-width:536px;margin:0 auto;pointer-events:none}
.toast{pointer-events:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;animation:rise .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.toast span{flex:1}.toast button{font-size:22px;line-height:1;padding:0 4px}

.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.tool{background:var(--card);border-radius:22px;padding:16px;text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-height:104px}
.tool b{font-weight:600;display:block}.tool div span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.sheet.tall{max-height:94vh}
.pd{background:var(--pill);padding:12px 12px;font-size:15px}
select.pd{padding:12px 8px}
.gr-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr .8fr 1fr auto;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.disp{background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;padding:14px 16px;min-height:88px;text-align:right;overflow:hidden}
.disp .ex{color:var(--mut);font-size:15px;min-height:20px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.disp .rs{font-size:34px;font-weight:700;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px}

.w2{grid-column:span 2}.w3{grid-column:span 3}.convtabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:2px}.convtabs .chip{white-space:nowrap}
.convrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 42px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}.convrow input,.convrow select{min-width:0}
.convswap{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);display:grid;place-items:center}

.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.pgrid button{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);padding:0}
.pgrid img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pv{width:100%;max-height:58vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card)}
.wph{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.wx{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--r);color:#fff;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;text-align:center}
</style>

  var rec=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LK)),salt=unb64(rec.s);
  return derive(pin,salt).then(function(k){
    return crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:unb64(rec.i)},k,unb64(rec.c)).then(function(pt){return{k:k,salt:salt,o:JSON.parse(td.decode(pt))}})})}
var _db=null;
function idb(){return _db||(_db=new Promise(function(res,rej){var r=indexedDB.open('planner',1);r.onupgradeneeded=function(){r.result.createObjectStore('f')};r.onsuccess=function(){res(r.result)};r.onerror=function(){rej(r.error)}}))}
function idbOp(mode,fn){return idb().then(function(db){return new Promise(function(res,rej){
  var tx=db.transaction(['f'],mode),rq;
  try{rq=fn(tx.objectStore('f'))}catch(e){rej(e);return}
  var done=false,result;
  if(rq){rq.onsuccess=function(){result=rq.result};rq.onerror=function(){rej(rq.error)}}
  tx.oncomplete=function(){if(!done){done=true;res(result)}};
  tx.onerror=tx.onabort=function(){if(!done){done=true;rej(tx.error||new Error('IndexedDB transaction failed'))}};
})})}
function idbGet(k){return idbOp('readonly',function(st){return st.get(k)})}
function idbSet(k,v){return idbOp('readwrite',function(st){return st.put(v,k)})}
function idbDel(k){return idbOp('readwrite',function(st){return st.delete(k)})}
function idbKeys(){return idbOp('readonly',function(st){return st.getAllKeys()})}
function packV(str){
  if(!cryptoKey)return Promise.resolve(str);
  var iv=crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  return crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:iv},cryptoKey,te.encode(str)).then(function(ct){return{iv:iv,ct:ct}})}
function unpackV(v){
  if(v==null)return Promise.resolve('');
  if(typeof v==='string')return Promise.resolve(v);
  if(!cryptoKey)return Promise.resolve('');
  return crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:v.iv},cryptoKey,v.ct).then(function(b){return td.decode(b)}).catch(function(){return ''})}
function putPic(k,str){return packV(str).then(function(v){return idbSet(k,v)})}
function getPic(k){return idbGet(k).then(unpackV)}
function migratePics(fin){
  return idbKeys().then(function(ks){return Promise.all(ks.map(getPic)).then(function(vals){
    cryptoKey=fin;
    return Promise.all(ks.map(function(k,i){return vals[i]?putPic(k,vals[i]):0}))})})}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}
function pc(p,a){var t=p+a;return t?p/t*100:null}
function f(n){return String(Number(n.toFixed(2)))}
function cur(){return S.subjects.find(function(x){return x.id===S.sel})}
function col(v){return v===null?'var(--mut)':v>=75?'var(--g)':'var(--r)'}
function cl(n){return n+' class'+(n===1?'':'es')}

function adv(p,a){
  var t=p+a,T=S.target;
  if(!t)return{ok:null,text:'Log a lecture to see your status'};
  if(p*100>=T*t)return{ok:true,text:'On track. Keep attending regularly.'};
  var y=Math.ceil((T*t-100*p)/(100-T));
  return{ok:false,text:'You must attend the next '+cl(y)+' consecutively to reach '+T+'%'}}

function gauge(v,T,name){
  var th=Math.PI*(1-T/100),c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),cx=140,cy=118,arc='M50 118A90 90 0 0 1 230 118',cc=col(v);
  var n=name.length>24?name.slice(0,23)+'…':name,an=c>0.35?'start':c<-0.35?'end':'middle';
  var sw='fill="none" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" pathLength="100"';
  return '<svg viewBox="0 -8 280 160" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Attendance gauge">'+
  '<path d="'+arc+'" '+sw+' style="stroke:var(--track)"/>'+
  (v===null?'':'<path class="garc" d="'+arc+'" '+sw+' style="stroke:'+cc+'" stroke-dasharray="'+v+' 100"/>')+
  '<line x1="'+(cx+82*c)+'" y1="'+(cy-82*s)+'" x2="'+(cx+100*c)+'" y2="'+(cy-100*s)+'" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" style="stroke:var(--ink)"/>'+
  '<text x="'+(cx+110*c)+'" y="'+(cy-110*s+4)+'" text-anchor="'+an+'" font-size="11" font-weight="600" style="fill:var(--mut)">'+T+'%</text>'+
  '<text x="140" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="40" font-weight="700" style="fill:'+cc+'">'+(v===null?'–':f(v)+'%')+'</text>'+
  '<text x="140" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" style="fill:var(--mut)">'+esc(n)+'</text>'+
  '<text x="50" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" style="fill:var(--mut)">0%</text>'+
  '<text x="230" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" style="fill:var(--mut)">100%</text></svg>'}

function home(){
  var fo=foc(),ev=upcoming().slice(0,3),h=new Date().getHours(),full=S.focusLen*60;
  var g=h<12?'Good morning':h<17?'Good afternoon':'Good evening';
  var d=fmtDate(new Date());
  var sub=tmr.done?'Session done. Tap to start':tmr.run?'Tap to pause':tmr.left<full?'Paused. Tap to resume':'Tap to start';
  var o='<div class="top"><div><p class="sub">'+g+'</p><h1>'+esc(S.name||'there')+'!</h1></div>'+
  '<div class="row" style="gap:10px"><button class="gear" data-a="dark" aria-label="Toggle dark mode">'+(isDark()?SUN:MOON)+'</button><button class="gear" data-a="opensheet" data-t="settings" aria-label="Settings"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h9M17 7h3M4 17h3M11 17h9"/><circle cx="15" cy="7" r="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="17" r="2"/></svg></button></div></div>'+
  '<div class="home"><div class="card today"><div><div class="t">Today</div><div class="sub">'+d+'</div></div>'+
  '<div class="evs">'+(ev.length?ev.map(function(e){return '<div class="ev"><span class="when">'+when(e)+'</span><span class="nm">'+esc(e.title)+'</span></div>'}).join(''):'<span class="sub">No upcoming events</span>')+'</div>'+
  '<button class="lnk" data-a="opensheet" data-t="events">+ Add event</button></div>'+
  '<div class="card small"><button class="tbtn" data-a="timer"><span>Focus timer</span><b class="big" id="tmv">'+mmss(tmr.left)+'</b><span>'+sub+'</span></button>'+
  (!tmr.run&&tmr.left<full?'<button class="lnk" data-a="treset">Reset</button>':'')+'</div>'+
  '<div class="card small qn"><span>Quick note</span><textarea id="qn" rows="3" placeholder="Type here…" aria-label="Quick note">'+esc(S.scratch)+'</textarea></div></div>'+
  '<div class="row sp sec"><h2>Projects</h2><button class="lnk" data-a="tab" data-t="proj">+ Add project</button></div><div class="grid">'+
  (S.projects.length?S.projects.slice(0,3).map(function(p){
    var dn=p.subs.filter(function(x){return x.done}).length,t=p.subs.length,pr=t?Math.round(dn/t*100):0;
    return '<button class="card nrow" data-a="tab" data-t="proj"><div class="row sp"><b>'+esc(p.name||'Untitled')+'</b><span class="sub">'+pr+'%</span></div>'+
    '<div class="bar"><i style="width:'+pr+'%;background:var(--ink)"></i></div><div class="due" style="margin-top:8px;'+(over(p)?'color:var(--r)':'')+'">'+dueTxt(p)+'</div></button>'}).join('')
  :'<div class="card sub empty">No projects yet.</div>')+'</div>'+
  '<div class="row sp sec"><h2>Attendance</h2><button class="lnk" data-a="tab" data-t="att">+ Add subject</button></div><div class="grid">'+
  (S.subjects.length?S.subjects.map(function(s){
    var v=pc(s.present,s.absent),c=col(v);
    return '<div class="card row prow"><button class="pmain" data-a="open" data-id="'+s.id+'"><div class="row sp"><b>'+esc(s.name)+'</b><b style="color:'+c+'">'+(v===null?'–':f(v)+'%')+'</b></div>'+
    '<div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(v||0)+'%;background:'+c+'"></i></div></button>'+
    '<button class="circ sm gr" data-a="qp" data-id="'+s.id+'" data-k="present" aria-label="Mark '+esc(s.name)+' present">✓</button>'+
    '<button class="circ sm rd" data-a="qp" data-id="'+s.id+'" data-k="absent" aria-label="Mark '+esc(s.name)+' absent">✕</button></div>'}).join('')
  :'<div class="card sub empty">Add your first subject in the Attendance tab.</div>')+'</div>'+toolsHtml();
  return o}

function att(){
  var s=cur(),T=S.target,o='<h1>Attendance</h1>';
  if(s){
    var v=pc(s.present,s.absent),ad=adv(s.present,s.absent),t=s.present+s.absent;
    var c=col(v);
    o+='<div class="card gauge">'+gauge(v,T,s.name)+'<p class="advice" style="color:'+c+'">'+ad.text+'</p></div>'+
    '<div class="card stats"><div><span>Attended</span><b>'+s.present+'</b></div><div><span>Missed</span><b>'+s.absent+'</b></div><div><span>Total classes</span><b>'+t+'</b></div></div>'+
    '<label class="lbl" for="sel">Select subject</label><select id="sel">'+
    S.subjects.map(function(x){return '<option value="'+x.id+'"'+(x.id===s.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select>'}
  o+='<label class="lbl" for="nm">Add new subject</label><div class="row"><input id="nm" placeholder="e.g. Data Structures" maxlength="40" autocomplete="off"><button class="circ add" data-a="addsub" aria-label="Add subject">+</button></div>';
  if(!s)return o+'<div class="card sub empty">Add a subject to start tracking.</div>';
  function mk(k,title,word,cls){
    return '<div class="card row sp mark"><div><b>'+title+'</b><div class="sub">'+s[k]+' '+word+'</div></div><div class="row">'+
    '<button class="circ" data-a="dec" data-k="'+k+'" aria-label="Remove one">−</button>'+
    '<button class="circ '+cls+'" data-a="inc" data-k="'+k+'" aria-label="Add one">+</button></div></div>'}
  o+=mk('present','Mark Present','attended','gr')+mk('absent','Mark Absent','missed','rd')+
  '<label class="lbl" for="tg">Target attendance requirement</label><div class="row"><input type="range" id="tg" min="50" max="90" step="1" value="'+T+'"><b id="tgv" style="min-width:48px;text-align:right">'+T+'%</b></div>'+
  '<div style="text-align:center"><button class="lnk danger" data-a="delsub">'+(pend==='s'+s.id?'Tap again to delete '+esc(s.name):'Delete this subject')+'</button></div>';
  return o}

function notes(){
  var o='<h1>Notes</h1><div class="row"><input id="nt" placeholder="New note title" maxlength="60" autocomplete="off"><button class="circ add" data-a="addnote" aria-label="Add note">+</button>'+scanBtn('ns','Scan a syllabus into a checklist')+'</div>';
  if(!S.notes.length)o+='<div class="card sub empty">Create a note, then break it into sub-notes you can tick off.</div>';
  S.notes.forEach(function(n){
    var dn=n.subs.filter(function(x){return x.done}).length,id=n.id;
    o+='<div class="card note"><input class="ntitle" data-f="title" data-id="'+id+'" value="'+esc(n.title)+'" placeholder="Title">'+
    '<textarea data-f="body" data-id="'+id+'" rows="3" placeholder="Write your notes here…">'+esc(n.body)+'</textarea>'+
    (n.subs.length?'<div class="subs">'+n.subs.map(function(x){
      return '<div class="sn'+(x.done?' dn':'')+'"><button class="chk" data-a="tog" data-id="'+id+'" data-s="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Toggle sub-note">'+(x.done?'✓':'')+'</button><span>'+esc(x.t)+'</span>'+
      '<button class="x" data-a="rmsn" data-id="'+id+'" data-s="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Remove sub-note">×</button></div>'}).join('')+'</div>':'')+
    '<div class="row"><input class="sin" data-id="'+id+'" placeholder="Add a sub-note" maxlength="80" autocomplete="off"><button class="circ sm add" data-a="addsn" data-id="'+id+'" aria-label="Add sub-note">+</button></div>'+
    '<div class="row sp"><span class="sub">'+(n.subs.length?dn+' of '+n.subs.length+' done':'No sub-notes yet')+'</span>'+
    '<button class="lnk danger" data-a="delnote" data-id="'+id+'">'+(pend==='n'+id?'Tap again to delete':'Delete note')+'</button></div></div>'});
  return o}

function ymd(d){var m=d.getMonth()+1,x=d.getDate();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+(m<10?'0':'')+m+'-'+(x<10?'0':'')+x}
function fmtDate(v){
  var d=v instanceof Date?v:new Date(String(v).length===10?String(v)+'T00:00':v);
  if(isNaN(d.getTime()))return String(v||'');
  return p2(d.getDate())+'/'+p2(d.getMonth()+1)+'/'+d.getFullYear();
}
function hm(d){return (d.getHours()<10?'0':'')+d.getHours()+':'+(d.getMinutes()<10?'0':'')+d.getMinutes()}
function upcoming(){
  var now=ymd(new Date())+' '+hm(new Date());
  return S.events.filter(function(e){return e.date+' '+(e.time||'23:59')>=now})
    .sort(function(a,b){return (a.date+(a.time||'00:00')).localeCompare(b.date+(b.time||'00:00'))})}
function when(e){
  var n=new Date();n.setDate(n.getDate()+1);
  var day=e.date===ymd(new Date())?'Today':e.date===ymd(n)?'Tomorrow':fmtDate(e.date);
  var ts=e.time?new Date('2000-01-01T'+e.time).toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}):'';
  return day+(ts?' · '+ts:'')}
function foc(){var t=ymd(new Date());if(S.focus.date!==t)S.focus={date:t,min:0,n:0};return S.focus}
function dur(m){return m>=60?Math.floor(m/60)+'h '+(m%60)+'m':m+' min'}
function mmss(x){var m=Math.floor(x/60),y=x%60;return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(y<10?'0':'')+y}
var tmr={run:false,done:false,left:S.focusLen*60,end:0,iv:null};
function saveTm(){S.tm={run:tmr.run,end:tmr.end,left:tmr.left};clearTimeout(svT);flush()}
function tick(){
  var l=Math.ceil((tmr.end-Date.now())/1000);
  if(l<=0){finish();return}
  tmr.left=l;var e=$('tmv');if(e)e.textContent=mmss(l)}
function finish(){
  clearInterval(tmr.iv);tmr.run=false;tmr.done=true;tmr.left=S.focusLen*60;
  var fo=foc();fo.min+=S.focusLen;fo.n++;S.tm=null;clearTimeout(svT);flush();
  try{if(window.Android&&Android.timerCancel)Android.timerCancel()}catch(e){}
  beep();try{if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate([400,200,400,200,400])}catch(e){}
  toast('Focus session done. Time for a short break.');render()}
function restoreTimer(){
  var t=S.tm;if(!t)return;
  clearInterval(tmr.iv);
  if(t.run&&t.end>Date.now()){tmr.end=t.end;tmr.left=Math.ceil((t.end-Date.now())/1000);tmr.run=true;tmr.done=false;tmr.iv=setInterval(tick,500)}
  else if(t.run){tmr.run=false;tmr.done=true;tmr.left=S.focusLen*60;var fo=foc();fo.min+=S.focusLen;fo.n++;S.tm=null;save();toast('Your focus session finished while you were away.')}
  else if(t.left){tmr.run=false;tmr.left=t.left}}
var ac=null;
function audio(){try{if(!ac)ac=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume()}catch(e){}}
function beep(){
  audio();if(!ac)return;
  var t=ac.currentTime,i,o,g;
  for(i=0;i<10;i++){
    o=ac.createOscillator();g=ac.createGain();o.type='square';o.frequency.value=i%2?880:1175;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t+i*0.35);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.35,t+i*0.35+0.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+i*0.35+0.3);
    o.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);o.start(t+i*0.35);o.stop(t+i*0.35+0.32)}}
function ent(c,id){return (c==='p'?S.projects:S.notes).find(function(x){return x.id===id})}
function over(p){return p.due&&p.due<ymd(new Date())&&!(p.subs.length&&p.subs.every(function(x){return x.done}))}
function dueTxt(p){return p.due?'Due '+fmtDate(p.due):'No due date'}

function proj(){
  var o='<div class="row sp"><h1>Projects</h1>'+scanBtn('ps','Scan project plan')+'</div><div class="row"><input id="pn" placeholder="New project name" maxlength="50" autocomplete="off"><button class="circ add" data-a="addproj" aria-label="Add project">+</button></div>';
  if(!S.projects.length)o+='<div class="card sub empty">Add a project, set a due date, and tick off tasks to fill the progress bar.</div>';
  S.projects.forEach(function(p){
    var id=p.id,dn=p.subs.filter(function(x){return x.done}).length,t=p.subs.length,pr=t?Math.round(dn/t*100):0;
    o+='<div class="card note"><input class="ntitle" data-c="p" data-f="name" data-id="'+id+'" value="'+esc(p.name)+'" placeholder="Project name">'+
    '<div class="row"><span class="due" style="'+(over(p)?'color:var(--r)':'')+'">'+(over(p)?'Overdue:':'Due date:')+'</span><input class="pd" type="date" data-c="p" data-f="due" data-id="'+id+'" value="'+esc(p.due||'')+'"></div>'+
    '<div><div class="row sp"><span class="sub">'+(t?dn+' of '+t+' tasks done':'No tasks yet')+'</span><b>'+pr+'%</b></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:'+pr+'%;background:var(--ink)"></i></div></div>'+
    (t?'<div class="subs">'+p.subs.map(function(x){
      return '<div class="sn'+(x.done?' dn':'')+'"><button class="chk" data-a="tog" data-c="p" data-id="'+id+'" data-s="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Toggle task">'+(x.done?'✓':'')+'</button><span>'+esc(x.t)+'</span>'+
      '<button class="x" data-a="rmsn" data-c="p" data-id="'+id+'" data-s="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Remove task">×</button></div>'}).join('')+'</div>':'')+
    '<div class="row"><input class="sin" data-c="p" data-id="'+id+'" placeholder="Add a task" maxlength="80" autocomplete="off"><button class="circ sm add" data-a="addsn" data-c="p" data-id="'+id+'" aria-label="Add task">+</button></div>'+
    '<div style="text-align:right"><button class="lnk danger" data-a="delproj" data-id="'+id+'">'+(pend==='p'+id?'Tap again to delete':'Delete project')+'</button></div></div>'});
  return o}

function sheetHtml(){
  if(!sheet)return '';
  var e0=sa?' enter':'',tall=(sheet==='gpa'||sheet==='calc'||sheet==='sci'||sheet==='conv'||sheet==='photos'||sheet==='photo'||sheet==='tasks')?' tall':'';
  var w='<div class="scrim'+e0+'" id="scrim"><div class="sheet'+e0+tall+'">',z='</div></div>';
  if(sheet==='name')return w+profForm(true)+z;
  if(sheet==='profile')return w+profForm(false)+z;
  if(sheet==='tasks')return w+tasksSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='gpa')return w+gpaSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='calc')return w+basicSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='sci')return w+sciSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='conv')return w+convSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='photos')return w+photosSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='photo')return w+photoSheet()+z;
  if(sheet==='settings')return w+'<h2>Settings</h2><span class="sub">Your name</span><input id="wn" value="'+esc(S.name)+'" maxlength="30" autocomplete="off"><button class="chip" data-a="opensheet" data-t="profile">Edit profile</button>'+
    '<span class="sub">Focus session length (minutes)</span><input id="sf" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="5" max="90" value="'+S.focusLen+'">'+
    '<span class="sub">Reminder time (sent the day before a test)</span><input id="rt" type="time" value="'+esc(S.remind)+'">'+
    toneUi()+statusUi()+themeUi()+wallUi()+lockUi()+'<button class="go" data-a="savename">Save</button><button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>'+z;
  var ev=upcoming();
  return w+'<h2>Upcoming events</h2><input id="et" placeholder="Event title, e.g. Physics test" maxlength="60" autocomplete="off">'+
    '<div class="two"><input id="ed" type="date" value="'+(evd||ymd(new Date()))+'"><input id="etm" type="time"></div>'+
    '<button class="go" data-a="addev">Add event</button>'+
    ev.map(function(e){return '<div class="evrow"><div class="ev"><span class="when">'+when(e)+'</span><span class="nm">'+esc(e.title)+'</span></div><button class="x" data-a="delev" data-id="'+e.id+'" aria-label="Delete event">×</button></div>'}).join('')+
    '<button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>'+z}

var MOON='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8z"/></svg>';
var SUN='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4M17.7 17.7l1.4 1.4M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4M17.7 6.3l1.4-1.4"/></svg>';
var THEMES=[['system','System','linear-gradient(135deg,#f4f4f6 50%,#0d0d10 50%)'],['light','Light','linear-gradient(135deg,#f4f4f6 50%,#3b6cf0 50%)'],['dark','Dark','linear-gradient(135deg,#0d0d10 50%,#3b6cf0 50%)'],['ocean','Ocean','linear-gradient(135deg,#0b1b2b 50%,#38a3ff 50%)'],['forest','Forest','linear-gradient(135deg,#0e1912 50%,#5fbf7a 50%)'],['sunset','Sunset','linear-gradient(135deg,#fff1e6 50%,#ff6a3d 50%)'],['lavender','Lavender','linear-gradient(135deg,#f2efff 50%,#7b5cf0 50%)']];
var WALLS=[['aurora','linear-gradient(135deg,#7f7fd5,#86a8e7,#91eae4)'],['dusk','linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3e50,#fd746c)'],['peach','linear-gradient(135deg,#ffecd2,#fcb69f)'],['night','linear-gradient(160deg,#0f2027,#203a43,#2c5364)'],['mint','linear-gradient(135deg,#d4fc79,#96e6a1)'],['berry','linear-gradient(135deg,#a18cd1,#fbc2eb)']];
function isDark(){
  var v=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--bg').trim();
  if(v.charAt(0)!=='#')return false;
  if(v.length===4)v='#'+v[1]+v[1]+v[2]+v[2]+v[3]+v[3];
  var n=parseInt(v.slice(1),16);
  return ((n>>16)*299+((n>>8)&255)*587+(n&255)*114)/1000<128}

function p2(n){return (n<10?'0':'')+n}
function trig(e){var d=new Date(e.date+'T00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);var q=(S.remind||'17:00').split(':');d.setHours(+q[0]||17,+q[1]||0,0,0);return d.getTime()}
function evStart(e){return new Date(e.date+'T'+(e.time||'23:59')).getTime()}
function remTxt(e){return fmtDate(new Date(trig(e)))+' '+new Date(trig(e)).toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}
function soon(){var l=new Date();l.setDate(l.getDate()+2);var z=ymd(l);return upcoming().some(function(e){return e.date<=z})}
function drawToasts(){var t=$('toasts');if(t)t.innerHTML=toasts.map(function(m,i){return '<div class="toast"><span>'+esc(m)+'</span><button data-a="closetoast" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Dismiss">×</button></div>'}).join('')}
function toast(m){toasts.push(m);if(toasts.length>4)toasts.shift();drawToasts();setTimeout(function(){var i=toasts.indexOf(m);if(i>=0){toasts.splice(i,1);drawToasts()}},5000)}
function checkRem(){
  if(locked||!pro())return;
  var now=Date.now(),ch=false;
  S.events.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.notified||trig(e)>now||evStart(e)<now)return;
    e.notified=true;ch=true;
    toast('Coming up: '+e.title+' · '+when(e));
    try{if(window.Notification&&Notification.permission==='granted')new Notification('Upcoming: '+e.title,{body:when(e)})}catch(x){}});
  if(ch){save();if(tab==='sched'||tab==='home')render()}}

    Android.sync(JSON.stringify(l))}catch(x){}}
function icsEsc(t){return String(t).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/;/g,'\\;').replace(/,/g,'\\,').replace(/\n/g,' ')}
function icsUtc(d){return d.getUTCFullYear()+p2(d.getUTCMonth()+1)+p2(d.getUTCDate())+'T'+p2(d.getUTCHours())+p2(d.getUTCMinutes())+'00Z'}
function ics(){
  var L=['BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//Sapp//EN'];
  upcoming().forEach(function(e){
    var d=e.date.replace(/-/g,'');
    L.push('BEGIN:VEVENT','UID:'+e.id+'@student-planner','DTSTAMP:'+icsUtc(new Date()));
    if(e.time){
      var en=new Date(e.date+'T'+e.time);en.setHours(en.getHours()+1);
      L.push('DTSTART:'+d+'T'+e.time.replace(':','')+'00','DTEND:'+d+'T'+(ymd(en)===e.date?p2(en.getHours())+p2(en.getMinutes()):'2359')+'00')}
    else L.push('DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:'+d);
    L.push('SUMMARY:'+icsEsc(e.title),'BEGIN:VALARM','ACTION:DISPLAY','DESCRIPTION:'+icsEsc(e.title),'TRIGGER;VALUE=DATE-TIME:'+icsUtc(new Date(trig(e))),'END:VALARM','END:VEVENT')});
  L.push('END:VCALENDAR');return L.join('\r\n')}
function readImg(file){return new Promise(function(res,rej){
  var rd=new FileReader();rd.onerror=function(){rej(new Error('read'))};
  rd.onload=function(){var im=new Image();im.onload=function(){res(im)};im.onerror=function(){rej(new Error('decode'))};im.src=rd.result};
  rd.readAsDataURL(file)})}
function draw(im,max){var k=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(im.width*k));c.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(im.height*k));c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);return c}
function toBlobP(im,max,q){return new Promise(function(res,rej){draw(im,max).toBlob(function(b){b?res(b):rej(new Error('blob'))},'image/jpeg',q)})}

  if(window.Tesseract)return Promise.resolve(window.Tesseract);
  return new Promise(function(res,rej){
    var sc=document.createElement('script');sc.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@5.1.1/dist/tesseract.min.js';
    sc.onload=function(){window.Tesseract?res(window.Tesseract):rej(new Error('tess'))};sc.onerror=function(){rej(new Error('net'))};document.head.appendChild(sc)})}
function ocrText(im){return loadTess().then(function(T){return T.recognize(draw(im,2000),'eng')}).then(function(r){return (r&&r.data&&r.data.text)||''})}
var MON={jan:0,feb:1,mar:2,apr:3,may:4,jun:5,jul:6,aug:7,sep:8,oct:9,nov:10,dec:11};
var KD={exam:'Exam',test:'Test',quiz:'Test',viva:'Exam',practical:'Exam',assignment:'Assignment',submission:'Assignment',project:'Assignment',lab:'Class'};
function mkDate(d,m,y){
  var n=new Date(),t0=new Date(n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n.getDate());
  if(y===null||y===undefined){y=t0.getFullYear();if(new Date(y,m,d)<t0)y++}
  else if(y<100)y+=2000;
  var c=new Date(y,m,d);
  return(c.getMonth()!==m||c.getDate()!==d)?null:ymd(c)}
function parseTT(text){
  var out=[],MN='(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)';
  String(text).split(/\n+/).forEach(function(raw){
    var ln=raw.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),date=null,rest=ln,m;
    if(ln.length<4)return;
    if(m=ln.match(/\b(20\d\d)[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})\b/)){date=mkDate(+m[3],+m[2]-1,+m[1]);rest=ln.replace(m[0],' ')}
    else if(m=ln.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{2,4})\b/)){date=mkDate(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]);rest=ln.replace(m[0],' ')}
    else if(m=ln.match(new RegExp('\\b(\\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?[\\s-]+'+MN+'[a-z]*\\.?,?(?:\\s+(\\d{4}))?','i'))){date=mkDate(+m[1],MON[m[2].toLowerCase()],m[3]?+m[3]:null);rest=ln.replace(m[0],' ')}
    else if(m=ln.match(new RegExp('\\b'+MN+'[a-z]*\\.?\\s+(\\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?(?:,?\\s+(\\d{4}))?\\b','i'))){date=mkDate(+m[2],MON[m[1].toLowerCase()],m[3]?+m[3]:null);rest=ln.replace(m[0],' ')}
    if(!date)return;
    var tm='',hh,mm=0,ap='',t=rest.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[:.](\d{2})\s*(am|pm)?/i);
    if(t){hh=+t[1];mm=+t[2];ap=(t[3]||'').toLowerCase();rest=rest.replace(t[0],' ')}
    else if(t=rest.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\s*(am|pm)\b/i)){hh=+t[1];ap=t[2].toLowerCase();rest=rest.replace(t[0],' ')}
    if(hh!==undefined&&hh<=23&&mm<60){if(ap==='pm'&&hh<12)hh+=12;if(ap==='am'&&hh===12)hh=0;tm=p2(hh)+':'+p2(mm)}
    var kw=rest.match(/exam|test|quiz|viva|practical|assignment|submission|project|lab/i),kind=kw?KD[kw[0].toLowerCase()]:'Event';
    var title=rest.replace(/\b(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)[a-z]*\b\.?/ig,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/^[\s|:;,\-–]+|[\s|:;,\-–]+$/g,'').replace(/\s+(on|at|by|due)$/i,'');
    out.push({title:(title.length>1?title:kind).slice(0,80),date:date,time:tm,kind:kind})});
  return out}
/*END-TT*/
function linesToItems(t){
  var seen={},out=[];
  String(t).split(/\n+/).forEach(function(l){
    l=l.replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/^(\d+[.)]|[-–•*·])\s*/,'').trim();
    var k=l.toLowerCase();
    if(l.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g,'').length<3||seen[k])return;
    seen[k]=1;out.push(l)});
  return out}

Add what you want to finish today.</div>')+

function sgpa(){var tc=0,tp=0;S.gpa.rows.forEach(function(r){var c=parseFloat(r.c);if(c>0){tc+=c;tp+=c*gpts(r.g)}});return tc?{v:tp/tc,c:tc}:null}
function cgpa(){var tc=0,tp=0;S.gpa.sems.forEach(function(r){var c=parseFloat(r.c),g=parseFloat(r.s);if(c>0&&g>=0){tc+=c;tp+=c*g}});return tc?{v:tp/tc,c:tc}:null}

  var o='<h2>SGPA / CGPA</h2><div class="chips">'+[['sgpa','SGPA'],['cgpa','CGPA'],['scale','Grade scale']].map(function(t){return '<button class="chip'+(gtab===t[0]?' sel':'')+'" data-a="gtab" data-v="'+t[0]+'">'+t[1]+'</button>'}).join('')+'</div>';
  if(gtab==='sgpa'){
    o+=S.gpa.rows.map(function(r,i){return '<div class="gr-row"><input class="pd" data-q="r" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="n" placeholder="Subject" value="'+esc(r.n||'')+'"><input class="pd" data-q="r" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="c" type="number" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Credits" value="'+esc(r.c)+'"><select class="pd" data-q="r" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="g">'+Object.keys(S.grades).map(function(g){return '<option'+(g===r.g?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(g)+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select><button class="x" data-a="gdel" data-k="r" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Remove">×</button></div>'}).join('')+
    '<button class="chip" data-a="gadd" data-k="r">+ Add subject</button>'}
  else if(gtab==='cgpa'){
    o+=S.gpa.sems.map(function(r,i){return '<div class="gr-row" style="grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr auto"><input class="pd" data-q="s" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="n" placeholder="Semester" value="'+esc(r.n||'')+'"><input class="pd" data-q="s" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="s" type="number" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="SGPA" value="'+esc(r.s)+'"><input class="pd" data-q="s" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="c" type="number" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Credits" value="'+esc(r.c)+'"><button class="x" data-a="gdel" data-k="s" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Remove">×</button></div>'}).join('')+
    '<div class="two"><button class="chip" data-a="gadd" data-k="s">+ Add semester</button><button class="chip" data-a="gimp">Use my SGPA</button></div>'}
  else{
    o+='<p class="sub">Points for each grade. Change them to match your university.</p>'+Object.keys(S.grades).map(function(g){return '<div class="row sp"><span>'+esc(g)+'</span><input class="pd" data-q="sc" data-f="'+esc(g)+'" type="number" step="0.5" value="'+S.grades[g]+'" style="width:96px"></div>'}).join('')}
  return o+(gtab==='scale'?'':'<div class="card"><b id="gres">'+gres()+'</b></div>')+'<button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>'}
function ginput(t){
  var q=t.dataset.q,f=t.dataset.f,i=+t.dataset.i;
  if(q==='sc')S.grades[f]=parseFloat(t.value)||0;
  else{var l=q==='r'?S.gpa.rows:S.gpa.sems;if(l[i])l[i][f]=t.value}
  save();var el=$('gres');if(el)el.textContent=gres()}

var calc={e:'',r:'',deg:true,ans:0,eq:false};
function evalX(src){
  var s=src.replace(/\s+/g,''),i=0;
  function fn(f,a){
    var k=calc.deg?Math.PI/180:1;
    switch(f){
      case 'sin':return Math.sin(a*k);case 'cos':return Math.cos(a*k);case 'tan':return Math.tan(a*k);
      case 'asin':return Math.asin(a)/k;case 'acos':return Math.acos(a)/k;case 'atan':return Math.atan(a)/k;
      case 'ln':return Math.log(a);case 'log':return Math.log10(a);case 'sqrt':return Math.sqrt(a);case 'abs':return Math.abs(a)}
    throw 0}
  function primary(){
    var c=s[i],m,v;
    if(c==='('){i++;v=expr();if(s[i]===')')i++;return v}
    m=/^(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)/.exec(s.slice(i));
    if(m){i+=m[0].length;return parseFloat(m[0])}
    m=/^[a-z]+/.exec(s.slice(i));
    if(m){
      var f=m[0];i+=f.length;
      if(f==='pi')return Math.PI;if(f==='e')return Math.E;if(f==='ans')return calc.ans;
      if(s[i]!=='(')throw 0;
      i++;v=expr();if(s[i]===')')i++;return fn(f,v)}
    throw 0}
  function post(){
    var v=primary();
    while(s[i]==='!'||s[i]==='%'){
      if(s[i]==='!'){if(v<0||v!==Math.floor(v)||v>170)throw 0;var r=1,j;for(j=2;j<=v;j++)r*=j;v=r}else v=v/100;
      i++}
    return v}
  function pow(){var b=post();if(s[i]==='^'){i++;return Math.pow(b,unary())}return b}
  function unary(){if(s[i]==='-'){i++;return -unary()}if(s[i]==='+'){i++;return unary()}return pow()}
  function term(){
    var v=unary();
    for(;;){
      var c=s[i],r;
      if(c==='*'||c==='/'){i++;r=unary();v=c==='*'?v*r:v/r}
      else if(c==='('||(c&&/[a-z]/.test(c))){v*=unary()}
      else break}
    return v}
  function expr(){
    var v=term();
    while(s[i]==='+'||s[i]==='-'){var o=s[i++],r=term();v=o==='+'?v+r:v-r}
    return v}
  var out=expr();
  if(i<s.length||!isFinite(out))throw 0;
  return out}
function fmtN(n){return String(parseFloat(n.toPrecision(12)))}
var KEYS=[['DEG','DEG','op'],['sin','sin(','op'],['cos','cos(','op'],['tan','tan(','op'],['AC','AC','op'],
['sin⁻¹','asin(','op'],['cos⁻¹','acos(','op'],['tan⁻¹','atan(','op'],['ln','ln(','op'],['log','log(','op'],
['√','sqrt(','op'],['x²','^2','op'],['xʸ','^','op'],['n!','!','op'],['%','%','op'],
['π','pi',''],['e','e',''],['Ans','ans',''],['(','(',''],[')',')',''],
['7','7',''],['8','8',''],['9','9',''],['÷','/','op'],['⌫','DEL','op'],
['4','4',''],['5','5',''],['6','6',''],['×','*','op'],['−','-','op'],
['1','1',''],['2','2',''],['3','3',''],['+','+','op'],['.','.',''],
['0','0','w2'],['=','=','eq w3']];
function dsp(e){return e.replace(/\*/g,'×').replace(/\//g,'÷').replace(/pi/g,'π').replace(/sqrt\(/g,'√(')}
function sciSheet(){
  return '<h2>Scientific calculator</h2><div class="disp"><div class="ex">'+esc(dsp(calc.e)||' ')+'</div><div class="rs">'+esc(calc.r||'0')+'</div></div><div class="calc">'+
  KEYS.map(function(k){return '<button class="ck '+k[2]+'" data-a="ck" data-v="'+k[1]+'">'+(k[1]==='DEG'?(calc.deg?'DEG':'RAD'):k[0])+'</button>'}).join('')+'</div><button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>'}
function basicSheet(){
  var ks=[['%','%','op'],['CE','AC','op'],['⌫','DEL','op'],['÷','/','op'],
    ['7','7',''],['8','8',''],['9','9',''],['×','*','op'],
    ['4','4',''],['5','5',''],['6','6',''],['−','-','op'],
    ['1','1',''],['2','2',''],['3','3',''],['+','+','op'],
    ['±','NEG',''],['0','0',''],['.','.',''],['=','=','eq']];
  return '<h2>Calculator</h2><div class="disp"><div class="ex">'+esc(dsp(calc.e)||' ')+'</div><div class="rs">'+esc(calc.r||'0')+'</div></div><div class="calc" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)">'+
    ks.map(function(k){return '<button class="ck '+k[2]+'" data-a="ck" data-v="'+k[1]+'">'+k[0]+'</button>'}).join('')+'</div>'+
    '<button class="chip" data-a="opensheet" data-t="sci">Scientific</button><button class="chip" data-a="opensheet" data-t="conv">Converters</button><button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>';
}

var conv={kind:'Length',from:0,to:1,val:''};
var CONVS={
  Length:{units:['mm','cm','m','km','in','ft','yd','mi'],base:[0.001,0.01,1,1000,0.0254,0.3048,0.9144,1609.344]},
  Area:{units:['mm²','cm²','m²','km²','in²','ft²','acre'],base:[0.000001,0.0001,1,1000000,0.00064516,0.09290304,4046.8564224]},
  Weight:{units:['mg','g','kg','t','oz','lb'],base:[0.000001,0.001,1,1000,0.028349523125,0.45359237]},
  Volume:{units:['mL','L','m³','gal','qt','pt'],base:[0.001,1,1000,3.785411784,0.946352946,0.473176473]},
  Speed:{units:['m/s','km/h','mph','knot'],base:[1,0.2777777778,0.44704,0.5144444444]},
  Time:{units:['ms','s','min','h','day'],base:[0.001,1,60,3600,86400]},
  Data:{units:['B','KB','MB','GB','TB'],base:[1,1024,1048576,1073741824,1099511627776]},
  Temperature:{units:['°C','°F','K'],base:null}
};
function cv(v,kind,from,to){
  v=parseFloat(v);if(!isFinite(v))return '';
  if(kind==='Temperature'){
    var c=from===0?v:from===1?(v-32)*5/9:v-273.15;
    return to===0?c:to===1?c*9/5+32:c+273.15;
  }
  return v*CONVS[kind].base[from]/CONVS[kind].base[to];
}
function convSheet(){
  var kinds=Object.keys(CONVS);
  var c=CONVS[conv.kind]||CONVS.Length;
  var a=c.units[conv.from]||c.units[0],b=c.units[conv.to]||c.units[1];
  var out=cv(conv.val,conv.kind,conv.from,conv.to);
  return '<h2>Unit converter</h2><div class="convtabs">'+kinds.map(function(k){return '<button class="chip'+(conv.kind===k?' sel':'')+'" data-a="convkind" data-v="'+k+'">'+k+'</button>'}).join('')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="convrow"><input id="cvv" class="pd" inputmode="decimal" value="'+esc(conv.val)+'" placeholder="Value"><button class="convswap" data-a="convswap" aria-label="Swap units">⇄</button><input class="pd" value="'+esc(out===''?'':fmtN(out))+'" readonly></div>'+
    '<div class="convrow"><select id="cvf" class="pd">'+c.units.map(function(u,i){return '<option value="'+i+'"'+(i===conv.from?' selected':'')+'>'+u+'</option>'}).join('')+'<option></option></select><span></span><select id="cvt" class="pd">'+c.units.map(function(u,i){return '<option value="'+i+'"'+(i===conv.to?' selected':'')+'>'+u+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select></div>'+
    '<button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>';
}

var viewId='';
function photosSheet(){
  return '<h2>Photo vault</h2><p class="sub">Keep important notes, formulas and timetables. They stay on this phone'+(cryptoKey?' and are encrypted.':'.')+'</p>'+
  '<label class="up" style="position:relative;overflow:hidden">Add photos<input type="file" id="pa" accept="image/*" multiple style="position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;cursor:pointer"></label>'+
  (S.photos.length?'<div class="pgrid">'+S.photos.map(function(ph){return '<button data-a="pview" data-id="'+ph.id+'" aria-label="Open photo"><img data-pid="'+ph.id+'" alt=""></button>'}).join('')+'</div>':'<div class="card sub empty">No photos yet.</div>')+
  '<button class="lnk" data-a="closesheet">Close</button>'}
function photoSheet(){
  var ph=S.photos.find(function(x){return x.id===viewId});
