  return '<img class="pv" id="pv" alt="">'+
  '<input id="ptt" data-pt="'+ph.id+'" placeholder="Title, e.g. Physics unit 2 notes" maxlength="60" value="'+esc(ph.title||'')+'">'+
  '<div class="two"><button class="chip" data-a="opensheet" data-t="photos">Back</button><button class="chip danger" data-a="pdel" data-id="'+ph.id+'">'+(pend==='ph'+ph.id?'Tap again to delete':'Delete')+'</button></div>'}
function loadThumbs(){document.querySelectorAll('img[data-pid]').forEach(function(im){getPic('t'+im.dataset.pid).then(function(u){if(u)im.src=u})})}
function loadPv(){getPic('p'+viewId).then(function(u){var im=$('pv');if(im&&u)im.src=u})}

function addWallData(u){
  return new Promise(function(res){
    var im=new Image();
    im.onload=function(){var id=uid();putPic('w'+id,u).then(function(){S.walls.push({id:id,th:draw(im,160).toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.6)});if(S.wall==='img')S.wall='p:'+id;save();res()}).catch(function(){res()})};
    im.onerror=function(){res()};im.src=u})}
function migrateOldWall(){
  var u='';try{u=localStorage.getItem(WKEY)||''}catch(e){}
  if(!u)return;
  try{localStorage.removeItem(WKEY)}catch(e){}
  wallData='';addWallData(u).then(function(){render()})}

var lastSheet='';
function rs(){
  var wv=$('wn'),sv=$('sf'),rv=$('rt'),sc=document.querySelector('.sheet'),st=(sc&&lastSheet===sheet)?sc.scrollTop:0;
  var wval=wv?wv.value:null,sfval=sv?sv.value:null,rtval=rv?rv.value:null;
  $('sheet').innerHTML=sheetHtml();sa=false;lastSheet=sheet;
  if(wval!==null&&$('wn'))$('wn').value=wval;
  if(sfval!==null&&$('sf'))$('sf').value=sfval;
  if(rtval!==null&&$('rt'))$('rt').value=rtval;
  sc=document.querySelector('.sheet');if(sc)sc.scrollTop=st;
  applyTheme();
  if(sheet==='photos')loadThumbs();
  if(sheet==='photo')loadPv()}

function render(){
  document.body.classList.toggle('lk',locked);
  if(locked){$('app').innerHTML='';$('sheet').innerHTML=lockHtml();applyTheme();return}
  var nm=$('nm'),keep=nm?nm.value:'';
  $('app').innerHTML=(!pro()&&tab!=='notes')?paywall():tab==='home'?home():tab==='att'?att():tab==='proj'?proj():tab==='sched'?sched():notes();
  $('app').classList.toggle('anim',an);an=false;
  rs();
  if(keep&&$('nm'))$('nm').value=keep;
  document.querySelectorAll('nav button').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t===tab);if(b.dataset.t==='sched')b.classList.toggle('hasdot',pro()&&soon())})}

function bump(id,k,d){
  var s=S.subjects.find(function(x){return x.id===id});if(!s)return;
  s[k]=Math.max(0,s[k]+d);save();render()}
function note(id){return S.notes.find(function(x){return x.id===id})}
function confirmTwice(key,fn){
  if(pend!==key){pend=key;render();setTimeout(function(){if(pend===key){pend=null;render()}},3500);return}
  pend=null;fn()}

var A={
  opensheet:function(b){sheet=b.dataset.t;sa=true;render()},
  login:function(){
    var n=$('pf-n'),v=function(id){var e=$(id);return e?e.value.trim():''};
    if(!n.value.trim()){n.focus();return}
    var dob=v('pf-dob');
    if(!/^\\d{8}$/.test(dob)){var d=$('pf-dob');if(d){d.focus();toast('Enter DOB as DDMMYYYY.')}return}
    var day=+dob.slice(0,2),mon=+dob.slice(2,4)-1,yr=+dob.slice(4);
    var dt=new Date(yr,mon,day);
    if(dt.getFullYear()!==yr||dt.getMonth()!==mon||dt.getDate()!==day||yr<1900||dt>Date.now()){var d2=$('pf-dob');if(d2)d2.focus();toast('Enter a valid DOB as DDMMYYYY.');return}
    S.name=n.value.trim();
    S.profile={name:S.name,dob:dob,year:v('pf-y'),course:v('pf-c'),branch:v('pf-b'),college:v('pf-u')};
    var first=!S.welcomed;S.welcomed=true;S.profileDone=true;save();
    A.closesheet();
    if(first)setTimeout(welcome,300)},
  nopen:function(b){try{Android.open(b.dataset.k)}catch(e){}},
  addtask:function(){
    var i=$('tk'),t=i.value.trim();if(!t){i.focus();return}
    S.tasks.push({id:uid(),t:t,date:ymd(new Date()),done:false});save();rs();var n=$('tk');if(n)n.focus()},
  tgtask:function(b){var t=S.tasks.find(function(x){return x.id===b.dataset.id});if(t){t.done=!t.done;save();rs()}},
  deltask:function(b){S.tasks=S.tasks.filter(function(x){return x.id!==b.dataset.id});save();rs()},
  gtab:function(b){gtab=b.dataset.v;rs()},
  gadd:function(b){
    if(b.dataset.k==='r')S.gpa.rows.push({n:'',c:'3',g:Object.keys(S.grades)[0]});
    else S.gpa.sems.push({n:'Sem '+(S.gpa.sems.length+1),s:'',c:''});
    save();rs()},
  gdel:function(b){(b.dataset.k==='r'?S.gpa.rows:S.gpa.sems).splice(+b.dataset.i,1);save();rs()},
  gimp:function(){
    var r=sgpa();
    if(!r){toast('Fill in the SGPA tab first.');return}
    S.gpa.sems.push({n:'Sem '+(S.gpa.sems.length+1),s:r.v.toFixed(2),c:String(r.c)});gtab='cgpa';save();rs()},
  convkind:function(b){conv.kind=b.dataset.v;conv.from=0;conv.to=1;conv.val='';rs()},
  convswap:function(){var x=conv.from;conv.from=conv.to;conv.to=x;rs()},
  ck:function(b){
    var v=b.dataset.v,r;
    if(v==='AC'){calc.e='';calc.r='';calc.eq=false}
    else if(v==='NEG'){if(calc.e){if(/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(calc.e))calc.e=calc.e.charAt(0)==='-'?calc.e.slice(1):'-'+calc.e}}
    else if(v==='DEG')calc.deg=!calc.deg;
    else if(v==='DEL')calc.e=calc.e.replace(/(asin\(|acos\(|atan\(|sin\(|cos\(|tan\(|ln\(|log\(|sqrt\(|ans|pi|.)$/,'');
    else if(v==='='){if(calc.e){try{r=evalX(calc.e);calc.ans=r;calc.r=fmtN(r)}catch(x){calc.r='Error'}calc.eq=true}}
    else{
      if(calc.eq){calc.e=(/^[+\-*\/^!%]$/.test(v)&&calc.r!=='Error')?'ans':'';calc.r='';calc.eq=false}
      calc.e+=v}
    rs()},
  pview:function(b){viewId=b.dataset.id;sheet='photo';rs()},
  pdel:function(b){
    var id=b.dataset.id;
    confirmTwice('ph'+id,function(){
      S.photos=S.photos.filter(function(x){return x.id!==id});
      idbDel('p'+id).catch(function(){});idbDel('t'+id).catch(function(){});
      sheet='photos';save();render()})},
  padd:function(inp){
    var fls=Array.prototype.slice.call(inp.files||[]).slice(0,20);if(!fls.length)return;
    inp.value='';toast('Saving '+fls.length+(fls.length===1?' photo…':' photos…'));
    var p=Promise.resolve(),ok=0;
    fls.forEach(function(fl){p=p.then(function(){return readImg(fl).then(function(im){
      var id=uid(),big=draw(im,2200).toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.82),th=draw(im,360).toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.68);
      return putPic('p'+id,big).then(function(){return putPic('t'+id,th)}).then(function(){return getPic('t'+id)}).then(function(){
        S.photos.unshift({id:id,title:'',ts:Date.now()});ok++;
      });
    })})});
    p.then(function(){save();render();toast(ok===fls.length?'Photos saved':'Saved '+ok+' of '+fls.length+' photos')})
     .catch(function(){save();render();toast('Photo storage failed. Try again after reopening the vault.')})
  },
  closetoast:function(b){toasts.splice(+b.dataset.i,1);drawToasts()},
  scan:function(inp){
    var fl=inp.files&&inp.files[0];if(!fl)return;
    inp.value='';
    scanMsg='Reading the photo. This can take a minute.';render();
    var today=ymd(new Date());
    function ai(im){
      if(!(smp&&imgOK))return Promise.reject(new Error('no-ai'));
      return toBlobP(im,1800,0.85).then(function(bl){
        return smp.json('This is a photo of a school or college timetable or exam schedule. Today is '+today+'. Find every test, exam, quiz, assignment deadline or other dated event. Reply with ONLY JSON like {"items":[{"title":"Physics - Unit Test","date":"YYYY-MM-DD","time":"HH:MM or empty string","kind":"Test"}]}. kind is one of Test, Exam, Assignment, Class, Event. Use 24-hour time. If a year is missing, use the next occurrence on or after today. If a date is unclear, give your best guess. If nothing dated is found, reply {"items":[]}.',{images:bl,modelTier:'default'});
      });
    }
    readImg(fl).then(function(im){
      return ai(im).then(function(r){
        var items=(r&&r.items)||[];
        return items.length?items:ocrText(im).then(parseTT);
      }).catch(function(){return ocrText(im).then(parseTT)});
    }).then(function(a){
      draft=a.filter(function(x){return x&&x.title&&/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(x.date||'')}).map(function(x){
        return{title:String(x.title).slice(0,80),date:x.date,time:/^\\d{2}:\\d{2}$/.test(x.time||'')?x.time:'',kind:String(x.kind||'Event').slice(0,20)}});
      scanMsg=draft.length?'Found '+draft.length+(draft.length===1?' item':' items')+'. Check the dates below.':'No dates found. Try a clearer photo or add them by hand.';
      render();
    }).catch(function(e){scanMsg='Could not read that photo. Check the photo and try again.';render()})
  },
  nscan:function(inp){
    var fl=inp.files&&inp.files[0];if(!fl)return;
    inp.value='';toast('Reading the photo…');
    readImg(fl).then(function(im){
      function ai(){
        if(!(smp&&imgOK))return Promise.reject(new Error('no-ai'));
        return toBlobP(im,1800,0.85).then(function(bl){
          return smp.json('This is a photo of a syllabus, chapter list or study notes. Reply with ONLY JSON like {"title":"Short title","items":["Topic one","Topic two"]}. List the topics, chapters or tasks in order as short checklist items (under 90 characters each, at most 60). If nothing is readable, reply {"title":"","items":[]}.',{images:bl,modelTier:'default'});
        });
      }
      return ai().then(function(r){
        return (r&&r.items&&r.items.length)?r:ocrText(im).then(function(t){return{title:'',items:linesToItems(t)}});
      }).catch(function(){return ocrText(im).then(function(t){return{title:'',items:linesToItems(t)}})});
    }).then(function(r){
      var it=((r&&r.items)||[]).map(function(x){return String(x).trim().slice(0,90)}).filter(function(x){return x.length>2}).slice(0,60);
      if(!it.length){toast('No text found. Try a clearer photo.');return}
      var ti=(r.title&&String(r.title).trim().slice(0,60))||'Scanned note';
      S.notes.unshift({id:uid(),title:ti,body:'',subs:it.map(function(x){return{id:uid(),t:x,done:false}})});
      save();toast('Added "'+ti+'" with '+it.length+' checklist items');render()
    }).catch(function(){toast('Could not read that photo. Try a clearer photo.')})
  },
  pscan:function(inp){
    var fl=inp.files&&inp.files[0];if(!fl)return;
    inp.value='';toast('Reading project plan…');
    readImg(fl).then(function(im){
      function ai(){
        if(!(smp&&imgOK))return Promise.reject(new Error('no-ai'));
        return toBlobP(im,1800,0.85).then(function(bl){
          return smp.json('Read this project plan, task sheet or handwritten project list. Reply ONLY JSON like {"title":"Project title","items":["Task one","Task two"]}. Extract actionable tasks in order, maximum 60 items, each under 90 characters. If no title is visible use "Scanned project".',{images:bl,modelTier:'default'});
        });
      }
      return ai().then(function(r){
        return (r&&r.items&&r.items.length)?r:ocrText(im).then(function(t){return{title:'Scanned project',items:linesToItems(t)}});
      }).catch(function(){return ocrText(im).then(function(t){return{title:'Scanned project',items:linesToItems(t)}})});
    }).then(function(r){
      var items=((r&&r.items)||[]).map(function(x){return String(x).trim().slice(0,90)}).filter(function(x){return x.length>2}).slice(0,60);
      if(!items.length){toast('No project tasks found. Try a clearer photo.');return}
      var title=(r.title&&String(r.title).trim().slice(0,50))||'Scanned project';
      S.projects.unshift({id:uid(),name:title,due:'',subs:items.map(function(x){return{id:uid(),t:x,done:false}})});
      save();toast('Added "'+title+'" with '+items.length+' tasks');render();
    }).catch(function(){toast('Could not read that photo. Try a clearer photo.')})
  },
  buy:function(){try{if(window.Android&&Android.subscribe)Android.subscribe()}catch(e){}},
  restore:function(){try{if(window.Android&&Android.refresh){Android.refresh();toast('Checking your subscription…')}}catch(e){}},
  addall:function(){
    var n=0;
    draft.forEach(function(d){
      if(!d.title||!d.date)return;
      if(S.events.some(function(e){return e.title===d.title&&e.date===d.date&&e.time===d.time}))return;
      S.events.push({id:uid(),title:d.title,date:d.date,time:d.time,kind:d.kind});n++});
    draft=[];scanMsg='';save();toast('Added '+n+' to your calendar');checkRem();render()},
  discard:function(){draft=[];scanMsg='';render()},
  export:function(){
    if(!upcoming().length){toast('Nothing to export yet.');return}
    var data=ics();
    if(window.Android&&Android.saveIcs){Android.saveIcs('planner-reminders.ics',data);return}
    (window.claude&&claude.use?claude.use('downloads').catch(function(){return null}):Promise.resolve(null)).then(function(dl){
      if(dl)return dl.save({filename:'planner-reminders.ics',data:data});
      var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type:'text/calendar'}));a.download='planner-reminders.ics';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove()
    }).catch(function(){toast('The calendar file was not saved.')})},
  notif:function(){
    if(!window.Notification){toast('Device notifications are not available here. In-app alerts and the calendar file still work.');return}
    Notification.requestPermission().then(function(){render()})},
  unlock:function(){
    var pn=$('pin'),m=$('pmsg');if(!pn||!pn.value)return;
    openRec(pn.value).then(function(r){
      S=norm(r.o.S);wallData=r.o.w||'';cryptoKey=r.k;saltB=r.salt;locked=false;fails=0;
      S.events=S.events.filter(function(e){return e.date>=ymd(new Date())});
      restoreTimer();if(r.o.w){addWallData(r.o.w);wallData=''}
      sheet=null;an=true;render();checkRem()
    }).catch(function(){
      fails++;pn.value='';
      if(m)m.textContent=fails>=5?'Too many tries. Wait 30 seconds.':'Wrong PIN.';
      if(fails>=5){pn.disabled=true;setTimeout(function(){fails=0;pn.disabled=false;if(m)m.textContent=''},30000)}})},
  lockNow:function(){
    saveEnc().then(function(){
      clearInterval(tmr.iv);tmr.run=false;cryptoKey=null;saltB=null;locked=true;S=norm({});wallData='';wallCache={id:'',url:''};sheet=null;render();
      setTimeout(function(){var pn=$('pin');if(pn)pn.focus()},60)})},
  setpin:function(){
    var a=$('p1').value,b=$('p2').value,m=$('pmsg');
    if(!window.crypto||!crypto.subtle){m.textContent='Encryption is not available in this browser.';return}
    if(a.length<4){m.textContent='Use at least 4 characters.';return}
    if(a!==b){m.textContent='The two PINs do not match.';return}
    saltB=crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
    derive(a,saltB).then(function(k){return migratePics(k)}).then(function(){return saveEnc()}).then(function(ok){
      if(!ok){cryptoKey=null;m.textContent='Could not store the encrypted data.';return}
      try{localStorage.removeItem(KEY);localStorage.removeItem(OLD);localStorage.removeItem(WKEY)}catch(e){}
      render()})},
  lockOff:function(){
    var pn=$('p1'),m=$('pmsg');
    if(!pn||!pn.value){if(m)m.textContent='Enter your PIN.';return}
    openRec(pn.value).then(function(){
      try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(S));if(wallData)localStorage.setItem(WKEY,wallData)}
      catch(e){if(m)m.textContent='Could not save. Free some space and try again.';return}
      try{localStorage.removeItem(LK)}catch(e){}
      return migratePics(null).then(function(){saltB=null;render()})
    }).catch(function(){if(m)m.textContent='Wrong PIN.'})},
  dark:function(){S.theme=isDark()?'light':'dark';save();render()},
  saveTones:function(){var a=$('tone-t'),b=$('tone-n');try{if(window.Android&&Android.setTones){Android.setTones(a?a.value:'',b?b.value:'');toast('Notification sounds updated.')}}catch(e){toast('Could not update notification sounds.')}},
  theme:function(b){S.theme=b.dataset.v;save();render()},
  wall:function(b){S.wall=b.dataset.v;save();render()},
  upload:function(inp){
    var fls=Array.prototype.slice.call(inp.files||[]).slice(0,10);if(!fls.length)return;
    function msg(t){var m=$('wmsg');if(m)m.textContent=t}
    msg('Saving '+fls.length+(fls.length===1?' photo…':' photos…'));
    var p=Promise.resolve();
    fls.forEach(function(fl){p=p.then(function(){
      return readImg(fl).then(function(im){
        var id=uid(),big=draw(im,1800).toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.8),th=draw(im,160).toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.6);
        return putPic('w'+id,big).then(function(){S.walls.push({id:id,th:th});S.wall='p:'+id})})})});
    p.then(function(){save();render()}).catch(function(){msg('One of the photos could not be saved. Try a JPG or PNG.');save();render()})},
  wdel:function(b){
    var id=b.dataset.id;
    S.walls=S.walls.filter(function(w){return w.id!==id});
    if(S.wall==='p:'+id)S.wall='none';
    if(wallCache.id===id)wallCache={id:'',url:''};
    idbDel('w'+id).catch(function(){});save();render()},
  closesheet:function(){var sc=$('scrim');if(!sc){sheet=null;render();return}sc.classList.add('leave');setTimeout(function(){sheet=null;render()},220)},
  savename:function(){
    var w=$('wn'),n=w.value.trim();if(!n){w.focus();return}
    S.name=n;if(S.profile)S.profile.name=n;var sf=$('sf'),rt=$('rt');if(rt&&rt.value&&rt.value!==S.remind){S.remind=rt.value;S.events.forEach(function(x){x.notified=false})}
    if(sf){var v=Math.min(90,Math.max(5,parseInt(sf.value,10)||25));S.focusLen=v;if(!tmr.run){tmr.left=v*60;tmr.done=false}}
    save();A.closesheet()},
  addev:function(){
    var t=$('et'),d=$('ed');
    if(!t.value.trim()){t.focus();return}
    if(!d.value){d.focus();return}
    S.events.push({id:uid(),title:t.value.trim(),date:d.value,time:$('etm').value});evd=d.value;save();render();
    var n=$('et');if(n)n.focus()},
  delev:function(b){S.events=S.events.filter(function(x){return x.id!==b.dataset.id});save();render()},
  timer:function(){
    if(tmr.run){
      tmr.left=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((tmr.end-Date.now())/1000));tmr.run=false;clearInterval(tmr.iv);
      try{if(window.Android&&Android.timerCancel)Android.timerCancel()}catch(e){}
    }else{
      audio();tmr.done=false;tmr.end=Date.now()+tmr.left*1000;tmr.run=true;tmr.iv=setInterval(tick,500);
      try{if(window.Android&&Android.timerStart)Android.timerStart(tmr.end,'Focus session')}catch(e){}
    }
    saveTm();render()},
  treset:function(){
    tmr.left=S.focusLen*60;tmr.done=false;tmr.run=false;clearInterval(tmr.iv);
    try{if(window.Android&&Android.timerCancel)Android.timerCancel()}catch(e){}
    S.tm=null;save();render()},
  addproj:function(){
    var i=$('pn'),t=i.value.trim();
    S.projects.unshift({id:uid(),name:t||'Untitled',due:'',subs:[]});i.value='';save();render()},
  delproj:function(b){
    confirmTwice('p'+b.dataset.id,function(){
      S.projects=S.projects.filter(function(x){return x.id!==b.dataset.id});save();render()})},
  tab:function(b){tab=b.dataset.t;an=true;window.scrollTo(0,0);render()},
  open:function(b){S.sel=b.dataset.id;save();tab='att';an=true;window.scrollTo(0,0);render()},
  qp:function(b){bump(b.dataset.id,b.dataset.k,1)},
  inc:function(b){bump(S.sel,b.dataset.k,1)},
  dec:function(b){bump(S.sel,b.dataset.k,-1)},
  addsub:function(){
    var i=$('nm'),n=i.value.trim();if(!n){i.focus();return}
    var ex=S.subjects.find(function(x){return x.name.toLowerCase()===n.toLowerCase()});
    if(ex)S.sel=ex.id;else{var s={id:uid(),name:n,present:0,absent:0};S.subjects.push(s);S.sel=s.id}
    i.value='';save();render()},
  delsub:function(){
    confirmTwice('s'+S.sel,function(){
      S.subjects=S.subjects.filter(function(x){return x.id!==S.sel});
      S.sel=S.subjects[0]?S.subjects[0].id:null;save();render()})},
  addnote:function(){
    var i=$('nt'),t=i.value.trim();
    S.notes.unshift({id:uid(),title:t||'Untitled',body:'',subs:[]});i.value='';save();render()},
  delnote:function(b){
    confirmTwice('n'+b.dataset.id,function(){
      S.notes=S.notes.filter(function(x){return x.id!==b.dataset.id});save();render()})},
  addsn:function(b){
    var id=b.dataset.id,i=document.querySelector('.sin[data-id="'+id+'"]'),t=i.value.trim(),n=ent(b.dataset.c,id);
    if(!t||!n){i.focus();return}
    n.subs.push({id:uid(),t:t,done:false});save();render();
    var ni=document.querySelector('.sin[data-id="'+id+'"]');if(ni)ni.focus()},
  tog:function(b){
    var n=ent(b.dataset.c,b.dataset.id),x=n&&n.subs.find(function(y){return y.id===b.dataset.s});
    if(x){x.done=!x.done;save();render()}},
  rmsn:function(b){
    var n=ent(b.dataset.c,b.dataset.id);
    if(n){n.subs=n.subs.filter(function(y){return y.id!==b.dataset.s});save();render()}}
};

document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  if(e.target.id==='scrim'&&sheet&&sheet!=='name'){A.closesheet();return}
  var b=e.target.closest('[data-a]');if(!b)return;
  var a=b.dataset.a;
  if(a!=='delsub'&&a!=='delnote'&&a!=='delproj')pend=null;
  if(!A[a])return;
  if(!allowed(a,b)){toast('Subscribe to Pro to use this.');return}
  A[a](b)});
document.addEventListener('input',function(e){
  var t=e.target;
  if(t.dataset.q){ginput(t);return}
  if(t.dataset.pt){var ph=S.photos.find(function(y){return y.id===t.dataset.pt});if(ph){ph.title=t.value;save()}return}
  if(t.dataset.g){
    var x=t.dataset.ev!==undefined?S.events.find(function(y){return y.id===t.dataset.ev}):draft[+t.dataset.dr];
    if(x){x[t.dataset.g]=t.value;if(t.dataset.ev!==undefined){x.notified=false;save()}}}
  else if(t.dataset.f){var n=ent(t.dataset.c,t.dataset.id);if(n){n[t.dataset.f]=t.value;save()}}
  else if(t.id==='qn'){S.scratch=t.value;save()}
  else if(t.id==='tg'){S.target=+t.value;$('tgv').textContent=t.value+'%';save()}});
document.addEventListener('change',function(e){
  if(e.target.dataset.g){if(e.target.dataset.ev!==undefined)render()}
  else if(e.target.id==='cvv'){conv.val=e.target.value;rs()}
  else if(e.target.id==='cvf'){conv.from=+e.target.value;rs()}
  else if(e.target.id==='cvt'){conv.to=+e.target.value;rs()}
  else if(e.target.id==='sel'){S.sel=e.target.value;save();render()}
  else if(e.target.id==='tg')render();
  else if(e.target.id==='wf')A.upload(e.target);
  else if(e.target.id==='tf')A.scan(e.target);
  else if(e.target.id==='ns')A.nscan(e.target);
  else if(e.target.id==='ps')A.pscan(e.target);
  else if(e.target.id==='pa')A.padd(e.target)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key!=='Enter')return;
  var t=e.target;
  if(t.id==='pin')A.unlock();
  else if(t.id==='tk')A.addtask();
  else if(t.id==='wn')A.savename();
  else if(t.id==='et')A.addev();
  else if(t.id==='pn')A.addproj();
  else if(t.id==='nm')A.addsub();
  else if(t.id==='nt')A.addnote();
  else if(t.classList&&t.classList.contains('sin'))A.addsn({dataset:{id:t.dataset.id,c:t.dataset.c}})});

loadToneList();
if(!locked){S.events=S.events.filter(function(e){return e.date>=ymd(new Date())});S.tasks=S.tasks.filter(function(t){return !t.done||t.date>=ymd(new Date())});migrateOldWall();restoreTimer();if(!S.name||!S.profileDone){sheet='name';sa=true}}
render();
if(locked){var p0=$('pin');if(p0)p0.focus()}else if(sheet==='name'){var w0=$('pf-n');if(w0)w0.focus()}
if(window.claude&&claude.use){claude.use('sample').then(function(sm){
  smp=sm;if(sm&&sm.limits)sm.limits().then(function(l){imgOK=!!(l&&l.images);if(tab==='sched'&&!locked)render()}).catch(function(){})}).catch(function(){})}
window.onPro=function(){if(!locked){render();syncNative()}};
checkRem();setInterval(checkRem,30000);syncNative();
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
  if(document.hidden){hiddenAt=Date.now();if(svT){clearTimeout(svT);flush()}}
  else if(cryptoKey&&Date.now()-hiddenAt>60000)A.lockNow();
  else{checkRem();if(tmr.run)tick()}});
window.__flush=function(){if(svT){clearTimeout(svT);flush()}};
window.addEventListener('pagehide',window.__flush);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
